decisions.issues: v01 (the only candidate) does not match the chapter 20 bible row for Nagoji. His long curly hair hangs loose with no Kerala topknot on the crown, which is the identity marker for the Ananthan Pillai era (the topknot appears in 1.2 and 1.4 on this page). He wears a sleeved white robe with a red sash instead of a bare-chested mundu and shoulder cloth. There is no silver chain of office, no conch knife at his waist and no grey at the temples. The leaf he is reading is a broad, sheet-like slab, not a narrow palm-leaf strip. What works: the room (lime-washed laterite, closed shutter, wall niche, woven mat, low table with string-bound bundles, single open-wick lamp), the clean chin, curled moustache, flush gold ear stud, the slight smile, and plenty of clear upper-left wall for both captions.
decisions.correction: Nagoji's hair must be gathered into a Kerala topknot high on the crown, as at the temple later on this page, never loose over his shoulders, with the first grey at the temples. He is bare-chested in a cream mundu with a cream shoulder cloth over one shoulder and bare arms. Do not draw a sleeved robe, tunic or shirt, and no red sash. A silver chain of office hangs on his chest, and the ivory-handled conch knife is tucked into the mundu's waist fold where it shows beside the mat. The leaf he reads is a single long, narrow palm-leaf strip, about a forearm long and two fingers wide, held in both hands, not a broad sheet. Keep everything else that worked: the lime-washed laterite room, the closed wooden shutter, the wall niche, the woven mat, the low table stacked with string-bound palm-leaf bundles, the single open-wick clay lamp and warm night light, the clean chin, thick curled moustache, flush gold ear stud, the faint lift at the corner of his moustache, and the plain, clear upper-left wall for the two captions.

decisions.correction: This is an extreme long shot of the sky and landscape. The clear morning sky fills the top two-thirds of the frame, and the temple roof and coconut palms sit low along the bottom third. Two hawks, wings spread, circle on the same column of air near the centre of the sky, one above the other on a shared curving path, large enough to read clearly. Do NOT draw Nagoji or Revathi in the foreground or at any readable size, and show no faces at all. They appear only as two tiny distant figures, each no taller than one twentieth of the frame height, one in cream and one in indigo, on the path along the stepped temple tank near the lower edge, walking toward each other from opposite ends with a wide gap between them. No procession, no women carrying lamps, no drummers, no lit lamps and no other people: the precinct is empty in the early morning. Keep the sloping tiled Kerala roof, the brass lamp-pillar, the coconut palms, the stepped tank with lotus and the open blue sky, leaving plenty of clear sky for the two captions.

decisions.correction: Nagoji must be in his Ananthan Pillai look, not the commander look. decisions.issues: Minor: Nagoji's silver chain hangs at his waist beside the knife instead of at his neck, and his mundu has a red-striped border. Both are acceptable in a tight insert. decisions.correction: Fix the brand: on Nagoji's LEFT wrist the Portuguese brand must be a pale, puckered, irregular patch of raised scar ridges, lighter than his skin and about the size of a large coin, on the INNER side of the forearm a hand's width above the wrist. To show it, Nagoji's LEFT hand cups Dhanaji's fist from below, palm up, so the inner wrist faces the viewer, while his RIGHT hand presses down on top; both hands close Dhanaji's fingers over the ivory knife handle. Nagoji also wears his silver chain of office around his neck on his bare chest, as in the two previous panels, and has no knife or sheath at his waist. Keep everything else that worked: the garlanded courtyard with drummers in bright morning light; Dhanaji's downcast, swallowing face under the white turban, with his short black beard and indigo quilted tunic; Nagoji's topknot, grey temples, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin and tiny gold ear stud; and clear sky and roof at the top of the frame for two speech balloons.

decisions.issues: The key beat fails. The only mark is a thin red line on Revathi's upper back below the necklace. decisions.correction: Show only Revathi. Nagoji and the priest are both outside this frame, and the guests at the back stay small and blurred. decisions.issues: Minor only: Nagoji's silver chain of office is not visible and there is no grey at his temples; Revathi's few grey threads are not visible. decisions.correction: The brand on the inner LEFT forearm, a hand's width above the wrist, must be an irregular, roughly palm-sized pale puckered patch of raised, ridged scar tissue with soft, melted edges, like old burned letters smeared past reading: NOT a ring, circle, wreath or crown of thorns, no spikes or points, no emblem or symbol of any kind, no cross, no letters or numerals. The long thin WHITE scar runs from the wrist toward the elbow BESIDE the patch, not through it. Keep everything else from the previous version: his left arm seen from his own point of view, palm up with the thumb on the left, the rolled cream cloth at the elbow; the thin young hand in a grey-brown sleeve sinking into the black storm wave on the left; the brass oil lamp standing on the earthen floor of a low, timber-beamed cellar with sacks and a clay pot on the right, with no barred window, grille or bars; the three images bleeding into one another without borders, storm dark giving way to dim lamplight, no faces and no text.

decisions.issues: Minor only: no visible chain of office on Nagoji; Revathi's jhumka earrings and few grey threads are not visible; the priest (back of head only, right foreground, face hidden) has a red rather than gold border on his shoulder cloth. decisions.correction: Make this a TIGHT insert close-up, not a two-shot: fill the frame with the side of Revathi's neck and throat, Nagoji's two hands (strong brown fingers, ridged nails, no rings or bracelets) pulling the third knot tight in the yellow thread, and the small gold tali pendant hanging on that thread high at her throat, clearly above and separate from the top of the longer flat-coin necklace. decisions.issues: Nagoji is drawn although the panel shows Revathi alone, and he is off model: no topknot (short loose hair), a gold border on his shoulder cloth and mundu, and a gold bracelet. decisions.correction: Show Revathi ALONE: Nagoji is off-panel to the right and out of frame (no head, no back, no hands; at most a blurred sliver of his plain white shoulder cloth with no border at the right edge), and the priest is off-panel too, with no bearded or grey-haired man in the foreground.
